Ava Chen: OmniHealth go-live tomorrow 09:00 PT. wants low-latency search/autocomplete. renewal-risk account. need prefill + streaming fallback runbook.
Ravi Patel: copy. expected traffic?
Ava Chen: ~50 qps steady, spike to ~300 qps first hour. PII-sensitive 100% tenant-scoped caches only.
Marta Lopez: proposed runbook bullets:
- prefill top-50 prefixes into tenant in-memory cache (3m TTL, sliding refresh)
- warm pool x4 GPUs for first 2h, canary 1% traffic 10m before full ramp
- batching: 5-10ms window, disable if p99 >150ms
- streaming fallback when prefill miss >200ms
Ravi Patel: ops commands:
curl -X POST https://console.api.redwood/prefill -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_TOKEN" -d '{"tenant":"omni","prefixes":["patient:","record:","rx:"]}'
POST /admin/prefill/dryrun {"tenant":"omni","sample_size":200} -> returns expected hit dist
Ava Chen: legal asks: tag cache entries no-export and KMS logs. add enforcement.
Ravi Patel: added tenant-cache-meta {"export":false,"kms":"redwood-kms-01"} enforcement in prefill lambda.
Liam O'Neill: recovery/fallback: switch to q4_0_small, batch-size=1, streaming-only, notify CS.
Marta Lopez: telemetry to /cs/telemetry: p99_ms, prefill_hit_pct, cost_delta. set renewal-watch if hit_pct <40 after 60m.
